faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about your stay at VIP UZBE
faq.q1: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.a1: Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is until 12:00 PM. Early check-in and late check-out are available upon request, subject to availability.
faq.q2: Do you offer airport transfer services?
faq.a2: Yes, we provide complimentary airport transfers for all suite bookings. Standard room guests can arrange transfers at a nominal fee through our concierge.
faq.q3: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
faq.a3: A gourmet breakfast buffet is included with all bookings. We offer international and traditional Uzbek cuisine options.
faq.q4: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a4: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), cash in UZS and USD, and bank transfers.
faq.q5: Do you have facilities for business meetings?
faq.a5: Yes, we have state-of-the-art conference rooms and event spaces with full AV equipment, catering services, and dedicated support staff.
faq.q6: Is Wi-Fi available throughout the hotel?
faq.a6: High-speed Wi-Fi is complimentary throughout the entire property, including all rooms, public areas, and event spaces.
